title: Lower semicontinuity of geometric component counts in flat proper families
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper flat morphism of finite presentation of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-flat-morphism] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $s\in S$, write $X_{\bar s}=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\kappa(s)}$ for its geometric fibre [def-weil-geometric-fibre]. Let $n(s)$ be the number of connected components (maximal nonempty connected subsets) of its underlying space [def-weil-connected-scheme]. Each $n(s)$ is finite, with $n(s)=0$ when $X_{\bar s}$ is empty. For every $s\in S$ there is an open neighbourhood $V$ of $s$ such that $n(t)\geq n(s)$ for every $t\in V$; equivalently, the integer-valued function $n$ is lower semicontinuous.

proof.text: Define the count by Nat.card of the connected-components type. A proper geometric fibre is Noetherian and has finitely many connected components; emptiness implies count zero. The component-count base-change theorem identifies the count after any base change.

At s, use the étale clopen-partition lemma to obtain g : U → S, u over s, and m clopen pieces whose traces in the geometric fibre over u are connected and nonempty. The connected-components clopen-partition equivalence identifies the count at s with m.

For each piece take its image under the flat locally-finitely-presented projection to U. These images are open and contain u. Their finite intersection W is an open neighbourhood of u. For w in W, each piece has nonempty geometric trace by faithful-flat field extension, so the disjoint clopen partition gives at least m connected components.
The étale map g is open. Its image of W is an open neighbourhood of s. Base-change invariance transfers the inequality from each w over t to n(s) ≤ n(t).

lean.statement: theorem Scheme.Hom.geometricComponentCount_lowerSemicontinuous {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] : ∃ n : S → ℕ, (∀ s : S, Finite (ConnectedComponents (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s) : Scheme.{u})) ∧ n s = Nat.card (ConnectedComponents (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s) : Scheme.{u}))) ∧ (∀ s : S, IsEmpty (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s) : Scheme.{u}) → n s = 0) ∧ ∀ s : S, ∃ V : S.Opens, s ∈ V ∧ ∀ t : S, t ∈ V → n s ≤ n t
